text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Haah... haah~...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Damn... pushing yourself all the way to 
your heart's absolute limit is pretty 
crazy...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah... What's my time?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Phew~~... One more set...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'll do this.

Early that morning, Air Shakur was pushing 
herself through pool training to boost her 
cardiovascular endurance.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Time's up. I'll leave the cleanup 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah.

Afterward, I remembered that I had 
forgotten to confirm some details 
regarding the interview, so I took the 
opportunity to head to her classroom.
choice_data_list:
(I'd like to know how she's doing in 
class, too.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I'm telling you it's pointless 
to debate whether 'Takashi-kun' exists. 
Stop bugging me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Takashi-kun caught up to his older 
brother, who was walking 5.6 km ahead, in 
5 minutes"... It's already stupid right 
from that point. They just slapped 
someone's name on it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What I want to discuss isn't "Takashi-kun" 
himself, but rather the method to make him 
exist in reality.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If Shakur-kun and I team up, we could even 
explore the possibility of a human running 
at 67 km/h.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This might even come in handy for race 
research! How exciting!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Cafe, you think so too, right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I don't know...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Cold as always, aren't you? ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Shakur, you've got a visitor.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—No, I'll leave that matter to you. Hand 
the data over to the reporters if 
necessary.
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll handle things on this end.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if that's all you needed, you 
could've just sent a LANE.
choice_data_list: I just happened to be passing by...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Or rather, didn't you just want to see 
how Shakur-kun was doing on a regular 
day?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. You really are extraordinarily 
curious about Shakur-kun, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, maybe I should introduce 
you to my friends properly?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You probably already know, but I am Agnes 
Tachyon. And this is Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

Agnes Tachyon, an Umamusume who loves 
experiments, and Manhattan Cafe, who 
carries an air of mystery... Both are 
Umamusume with promising futures.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We haven't debuted yet, but we may clash 
with Shakur-kun eventually. ...Well, 
that's just speculation, of course.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded every day by wonderful friends 
like Cafe and myself, Shakur leads a 
delightfully comical and merry academy 
life.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Right, you two?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You're done with your business, right? 
Get going already."

Watching her earlier, it seems she's being 
true to herself in class. I feel like I 
caught a small glimpse of her everyday 
side.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You looked so happy that it made me 
smile too!

"Fine Motion. A descendant of royal blood, 
now registered in Ireland. A girl I 
occasionally spot hanging out with Air 
Shakur."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Say, is it a fun story? Would you mind 
sharing it with me, if it's alright?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so that's what happened. Tachyon 
really is such an entertaining girl.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure their fields are different, but 
Shakur always looks like he's having fun 
to me whenever he's talking about 
complicated things with Tachyon.
choice_data_list: It did look that way... maybe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then it might just be right! After all, 
you're my Trainer, and you're the one 
saying it.
choice_data_list:
Right now, I'm "just your Trainer" though, 
you know.

text_block_list.text:
Our level of mutual understanding hasn't 
deepened since we first met. As for the 
relationship itself, all that's expected 
of it is currently just an uncertain 
variable.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Still... right now, well...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know... the very first time I talked 
to Shakur... he told me, "Stay away from 
me"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She looked me right in the eye, and 
through both her words and actions, gave 
me a flat-out rejection, telling me to 
'stay out of it.'

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It felt so fresh, and it made me really 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I also love roundabout words for their 
beauty. I love the thoughtfulness poured 
into them. But...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shakur demonstrated total synergy between 
mind, word, and body without a single 
hitch.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to be as honest with 
myself as possible."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Just being yourself... without 
hesitating over who you want to be, I 
think.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I believe that doing what I need to do 
will lead to connecting with her 
sincerely.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"When I'm with Shakur, I feel it all the 
more."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What do I want to do... What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! About today, though... Keep it a 
secret from Shakur, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, they'll ask me, "What kind of 
nonsense were you feeding her?!"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Bodyguard
text_block_list.text: Your Highness, it is almost time...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Let's take our time and chat again soon. 
Well then, have a lovely day♪"

I mull over Fine Motion's words. What I 
ought to achieve... perhaps I need to give 
it more thought.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You were talking to Fine, weren't you? I 
could see you two making a fuss all the 
way from the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"What in the world did that 'Highness' 
fill her head with?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi, what're you smirkin' at? Spill it 
right here, right now, seriously."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... That idiot definitely ran their 
mouth.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, do you really have time to be 
standing around grinning?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's not a millimeter of give in that 7 
cm. Stop goofing off and put your head to 
work, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Told you, didn't I? Uncertain variables or 
whatever, if it's useful, I'll use it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"The same goes for your ideas. I don't 
expect a damn thing, but even if it's 
zero, having one is different from having 
none."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"So think. Unless you like being treated 
like an ornament."

Air Shakur has never said my very presence 
is unnecessary. If so, there must still be 
things I need to do as her Trainer.
choice_data_list: Thanks, I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I never told you to bust your butt.
